text: ANT01 Antenna Parameters for Network Planning — gain (dBi/dBd), beamwidth, F/B ratio, polarisation, azimuth & tilt Expert click to expand ▾ In plain English An antenna does not create power. How it worksDCI 0_0/0_1 schedule UL (PUSCH), 1_0/1_1 schedule DL (PDSCH); 0_1/1_1 are the richer non-fallback formats. NR limits the number of distinct DCI sizes a UE must monitor (size alignment) to bound blind-decoding attempts.
